visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men in white t-shirts walk on a wet urban sidewalk under a building overhang. One tanned man with a black watch points excitedly behind him toward a large black truck passing on the street while looking into the camera. (2) The men turn and run toward the truck, which has a massive LED screen displaying a video advertisement featuring their own faces and products. They gesture wildly with their arms, displaying intense excitement. (3) On the rainy city street lined with parked cars, one man holds up a smartphone to film the truck while the other poses next to it. A scooter and other cars pass by on the wet asphalt. (4) A close-up shot shows two smartphone screens displaying the clear video footage of the ad truck they just recorded. (5) The duo walks past a stone lion statue on a paved sidewalk, engaging in a lively conversation with expressive hand movements and wide smiles. (6) The men stand directly in front of the large LED screen on the parked truck, presenting to the camera while the screen displays brand information, their portraits, and the product name 'SALAD'. (7) They stand on the sidewalk waving goodbye to the truck as it drives away down a city street under an overcast, gray sky.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 2 main creators (Ian and Eric), and about 3 passers-by/scooter riders in the background.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: Two adult males; one with tanned skin wearing a white t-shirt, light blue jeans, and a black watch; the other with fairer skin wearing a white t-shirt and dark blue shorts.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Modern urban streets in Taipei with tall office buildings, retail storefronts, building overhangs, and sidewalks. There are parked cars, a stone lion statue, and a large black truck with a functional LED screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop BGM kicks in with a strong 4/4 beat. Two adult male voices immediately shout in Mandarin with extremely high arousal, 'Look! Look! Look at the back!', their pitch rising sharply. Faint ambient sounds of wet tire friction are audible. (2) Vocal intensity remains high as Voice A shouts 'Impossible!' followed by excited laughter. The BGM maintains a bright, synthesized texture. A subtle whoosh SFX marks a quick cut. (3) The speakers' speed of speech is fast as they instruct each other to record the truck. Voice B's tone is friendly and melodic. The BGM remains dominant but clearly below the vocals. (4) Vocal arousal dips slightly into a narrative tone as Voice B reflects on seeing stars on such trucks before. BGM continues steadily. (5) Both male voices rise in volume and pitch as they explicitly thank the brand '全清' and their fans. High-frequency digital SFX punctuate the speech for emphasis. (6) Hard cut in the music for the final phase. The male voices become casual and humorous, reminding viewers where the truck will be. Ambient urban traffic and wind noise become more prominent as the music fades.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document the creators' excitement upon seeing their first giant truck-side advertisement in Taipei and to promote the brand partnership with 'SALAD' (全清). The video serves as both a lifestyle update for fans and a commercial endorsement by encouraging viewers to spot the truck and tag them on social media.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creators explicitly name the brand '全清' (SALAD), refer to themselves as 'brand friends', show their ad campaign on the truck, and promote specific locations and dates for the ad truck tour.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video features the well-known YouTube duo 'The DoDo Men'. The high-energy editing and emotional authenticity are key drivers for engagement. The rain-slicked urban setting adds a specific atmospheric layer to the visual data.
